dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Waiting for the monsters to die of old age, Kinich? Or did they pound that thick skull of yours into the ground enough that even you decided to just find a cozy little corner to play dead in?

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: I seem to recall that your face was the one being used as a mop.

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Wha... M—Mere hallucinations, born of your exhaustion! Why, I remain full of spit and vinegar!

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: I gather information first by force of habit. But this Domain is constantly shifting, making it difficult to get a holistic view. We should be careful as we progress.

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Ohohoho, lost your nerve, have you, Kinich? And here I thought you were an adrenaline junkie!

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: The Almighty Dragonlord, K'uhul Ajaw perceives that ahead lies an extremely extreme "challenge" with your name on it! Surely you wouldn't want such a fantastic opportunity to slip through your fingers and into the grasp of another? Hehehehe...

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Oh for the love of— What kind of third-rate literary landfill is this? Not one single volume in the whole crummy place extols the illustrious, incomparable achievements of the Almighty Dragonlord, K'uhul Ajaw!

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Save your strength. You know your station.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: In the end, most of these are no more than the shallow opinions of others. I'd advise you not to halt your journey on their account. It's not worth it.
